title: a native pin is checked over the COMPLETE transitive graph: a requirement four calls away still fails the pin, and the dependency path names every hop
notes: specification/compatibility.mdx, 'Native Pin': 'A native pin MUST be a checked assertion over the COMPLETE transitive graph', and 'The diagnostic SHOULD show the dependency path that introduced the requirement.' A pin failure without a path tells a user that something in a program requires TypeScript and nothing about what, so the path is the part of the rule that makes the diagnostic actionable. This case separates the pin from the requirement by four ordinary calls; a-pin-reaching-typescript-is-rejected pins the one-hop case. poc/src/targets/classify.test.ts 'the pin diagnostic is reported at the assertion, with every hop of the path' asserts the full message text, including across module boundaries, which a corpus expectation cannot (it compares codes and positions only).
